content: {"praised":["Otter is charming, lovable, and entertaining.","British humor is witty, not overly sweet.","Scotland’s scenery is magnificent and beautifully captured.","Story shows genuine bond between man and otter.","Film avoids Disneyesque sugar‑coating, feels authentic."],"criticized":["Acting is weak and unconvincing.","Writing feels corny and melodramatic.","Music is dreadful and poorly matched.","Pacing is slow, takes forever to start.","Traumatic scenes of otter’s death are disturbing."]}
